description.narrow: Sepilok — лесная visitor locality западнее Sandakan вокруг Kabili-Sepilok reserve и orangutan rehabilitation infrastructure.

primary_location.note: locality node; not the rehabilitation-centre entrance

migration.note: Legacy route regions/hubs are kept as geographic_area until formal administrative or settlement identity is verified.

geography: Lowland tropical rainforest edge; visitor movement идёт по road access и разрешённым boardwalks.

climate.summary: Жаркий влажный климат восточного Sabah; ливни возможны круглый год, с более влажным северо-восточным муссонным периодом.

annual_reference.data_basis: peer-reviewed Sepilok Forest Reserve study; Sandakan Airport climate data cited from Malaysia Meteorological Service
annual_reference.caveat: Температура опубликована диапазоном; не сводится искусственно к одной цифре.

transport.summary: Sabah Tourism places Sepilok roughly 23 km / about 40 min from Sandakan city centre; road access, затем visitor boardwalks.

nature.summary: Главный природоохранный контекст — rehabilitation of orangutans в лесной среде; presence at feeding platforms is not guaranteed.
